comment: Built from content/housing.json by tools/content/contentc.mjs (npm run content): edit there, not here. Houses: what a blueprint builds, in which stages, from which material packs. Read by src/content/housing.ts. Each stage is finished by hauling its material packs to the site (on your back or in a cart) and paying its labor. Tax is copper per real day of world time, paid at the plot a week at a time. `neglect`: a house whose tax goes unpaid comes down `demolishAfterDays` real days after what was paid runs out, chest and all, and its plot is free for anyone to claim. An unclaimed plot is marked out with the structure plotMarker names.
